$description: Primary Simplified palette: the single source of colour for the theme and everything that follows it. Every hue has 14 steps with the names and OKLCH lightness of the gray in the same mode, so a step means the same thing in every hue (roles in $extensions). Do not write a colour outside this file; use color-mix() with a step for transparency.

light.30: sunken section, code background, soft hue tint
light.70: strong line, input outline, light hue fill
light.100: hover fill, icon; large text only (3:1)
light.110: muted text and hue text: >= 4.5:1 on steps 10-30
light.120: text on a tint of the same hue (steps 30-60)

primary-simplified.method: Grays unchanged from the theme. Hues: OKLCH hue and chroma curves through anchor points (steps 20-40 of the former --color-l/d-* scales and the danger, summary, success, tip, abstract, todo, tldr and bug callouts), sampled at the gray's lightness. Background steps are the hue vector added to the gray, so tints stay warm. Out-of-gamut values are clipped by lowering chroma. scripts/palette.mjs check enforces the rules.
primary-simplified.source: Primary by Cecilia May (GPL-3.0), Primary Simplified by voitech
